<style>
/* Scoped presentation helpers. Text, media, spacing, type and colour controls remain native. */
:where(.ss-design) { --ss-ink:#181a16; --ss-olive:#7e8e76; --ss-cream:#f8f5eb; --ss-tan:#d6c3ae; color:var(--ss-ink); font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; }
:where(.ss-design) * { box-sizing:border-box; }
:where(.ss-design) a { text-decoration:none; }
:where(.ss-design) p:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
:where(.ss-design) .elementor-heading-title { text-transform:none; }
:where(.ss-design) em { font-weight:400; }
:where(.ss-design) :focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:5px; }
.ss-design.ss-wrap { max-width:min(1320px,calc(100% - 10vw)); margin-inline:auto; }
.ss-design.ss-zero { min-height:0; height:0; overflow:visible; padding:0; margin:0; }
.ss-design .ss-link .elementor-button { padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; }
.ss-design .ss-button .elementor-button { min-height:50px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:28px; }
.ss-design .ss-has-arrow .elementor-button-content-wrapper { width:100%; }
.ss-design .ss-has-arrow .elementor-button-text { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:28px; text-align:left; }
.ss-design .ss-has-arrow .elementor-button-text::after { content:'↗'; font-size:21px; line-height:1; }
.ss-design .ss-card-image img { display:block; width:100%; height:330px; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .35s ease; }
.ss-design .ss-card-image { overflow:hidden; }
.ss-design .ss-card-image:hover img { transform:scale(1.025); }
.ss-design .ss-hero { isolation:isolate; }
.ss-design .ss-logo img { width:92px; height:80px; object-fit:contain; }
.ss-design .ss-story-image img { width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:1; object-fit:cover; border:8px solid #f8f5eb; }
.ss-design .ss-soak-image img { width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:1.93; object-fit:cover; }
.ss-design .ss-soak-card { z-index:2; }
.ss-design .ss-guide-image img { width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:1.7; object-fit:cover; }
.ss-design .ss-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title { line-height:1.7; }
.ss-design .ss-style-widget { width:100%; margin:0; }
.ss-search { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr .85fr 1.15fr; background:white; padding:20px; border:1px solid #e5e4da; box-shadow:0 12px 40px #0000000b; font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; }
.ss-search label { display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:3px 24px; border-right:1px solid #d8d8cc; min-width:0; }
.ss-search label span { font-size:9px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.15em; text-transform:uppercase; }
.ss-search input,.ss-search select { font:16px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; width:100%; color:#181a16; background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:4px 0; min-height:32px; min-width:0; }
.ss-search label:nth-child(3) { border:0; }
.ss-search button { background:#7e8e76; color:#000; border:0; border-radius:0; font:12px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; min-height:62px; padding:15px 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:15px; cursor:pointer; }
.ss-search button span { font-size:23px; }
.ss-search button:hover { background:#9ba78f; }
.ss-search-error { font:14px/1.6 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#82382a; margin-top:12px; }
.ss-search-note { font:11px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#595d54; margin:12px 0 0; }
.ss-search-note a { text-decoration:underline; color:inherit; }
.ss-mobile-menu { position:relative; font:13px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; }
.ss-mobile-menu summary { min-height:44px; display:flex; align-items:center; cursor:pointer; list-style:none; }
.ss-mobile-menu summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
.ss-mobile-menu nav { position:absolute; right:0; top:52px; z-index:90; min-width:240px; padding:18px 24px; background:#f8f5eb; box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0002; }
.ss-mobile-menu nav a { display:block; font:23px/1.3 Georgia,serif; color:#181a16; padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #d6c3ae; }
@media(max-width:1024px) {
  .ss-design.ss-wrap { max-width:calc(100% - 64px); }
  .ss-design .ss-card-image img { height:270px; }
  .ss-search label { padding-inline:16px; }
}
@media(max-width:767px) {
  .ss-design.ss-wrap { max-width:calc(100% - 48px); }
  .ss-design .ss-logo img { width:74px; height:68px; }
  .ss-design .ss-card-image img { height:auto; aspect-ratio:1.16; }
  .ss-design .ss-soak-image img { aspect-ratio:1.25; }
  .ss-design .ss-story-image { max-width:390px; }
  .ss-search { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; padding:10px; }
  .ss-search label { padding:14px; min-height:80px; }
  .ss-search label:nth-child(2) { border:0; }
  .ss-search label:nth-child(3) { border-top:1px solid #d8d8cc; }
  .ss-search button { margin:8px 0 0 8px; padding-inline:15px; }
  .ss-search input,.ss-search select { font-size:16px; }
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ss-design * { transition:none!important; animation:none!important; scroll-behavior:auto!important; } }

/* Editable native containers. Code supplies layout and interactions, not editorial copy. */
.sp-property { background:#fcfbf7;--sp-header:0px;--sp-nav:62px; }
.sp-property .sp-wrap { width:min(1320px,calc(100% - 10vw));max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:26px 0 90px; }
.sp-property .elementor-widget-text-editor p { margin:0 0 16px; }
.sp-property .sp-gallery { display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;height:490px;gap:8px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:5px;position:relative;margin:16px 0 45px; }
.sp-gallery > .elementor-widget-image { height:100%;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:0; }
.sp-gallery .elementor-widget-container,.sp-gallery a,.sp-gallery img { display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover; }
.sp-gallery .sp-gallery-main { grid-row:span 2; }
.sp-gallery > .elementor-widget-button { position:absolute;right:20px;bottom:20px;width:auto;background:#f8f5eb; }
.sp-gallery > .elementor-widget-button .elementor-button { padding:12px 18px!important; }
.sp-property .sp-layout { display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 355px;gap:clamp(40px,7vw,100px);align-items:start; }
.sp-property .sp-editorial { min-width:0; }
.sp-heading .elementor-widget-heading { margin-bottom:15px!important; }
.sp-heading .elementor-widget-text-editor { font-size:14px; }
.sp-signature { border-block:1px solid #d8d8cc;padding:20px 0!important;margin-top:20px; }
.sp-signature > .elementor-widget-image { width:70px!important;min-width:70px; }
.sp-signature .sp { width:auto; }
.sp-signature p { font-size:12px; }
.sp-section { padding:42px 0!important;border-bottom:1px solid #d8d8cc;scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--sp-header,0px) + var(--sp-nav,62px) + 20px); }
.sp-section > .elementor-widget-heading { margin-bottom:20px!important; }
.sp-section .elementor-button { border:1px solid #d6c3ae!important;background:#f8f5eb!important;padding:11px 17px!important;text-decoration:none!important;min-height:44px; }
.sp-property .sp-highlights { display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;padding:30px 0!important;border-bottom:1px solid #d8d8cc; }
.sp-highlights p { font-size:12px; }
.sp-property .sp-sleep-grid { display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px; }
.sp-sleep-grid img { width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.35;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px; }
.sp-sleep-grid .elementor-widget-heading { margin-top:16px; }
.sp-sleep-grid p { font-size:12px; }
.sp-amenities-preview ul { display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px 24px;list-style:none;padding:0; }
.sp-amenities-preview li::before { content:'✓';color:#617256;margin-right:12px; }
.sp-help { margin-top:40px;padding:30px!important;background:#f8f5eb;border-left:2px solid #7e8e76; }
.sp-help > .elementor-widget-heading { margin-bottom:15px; }
.sp-rule-buttons { gap:15px!important;flex-wrap:wrap; }
.sp-property .sp-booking { background:#f8f5eb;border:1px solid #d8d8cc;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 15px 45px #483c2610;padding:28px!important;position:sticky;top:calc(var(--sp-header,0px) + 20px); }
.sp-property.sp-nav-on .sp-booking { top:calc(var(--sp-header,0px) + var(--sp-nav,62px) + 20px); }
.sp-booking > .elementor-widget-heading { margin-bottom:15px!important; }
.sp-booking p { font-size:12px; }
.sp-preview-form { display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:12px; }
.sp-preview-form label { font:12px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;display:block;padding:12px 8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d6c3ae; }
.sp-preview-form input,.sp-preview-form select { display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;background:transparent;padding:8px 0;border:0;font:14px Arial,sans-serif;color:#181a16; }
.sp-full { grid-column:1/-1; }
.sp-preview-form button { min-height:54px;margin-top:18px;background:#7e8e76;color:#181a16;border:0;font:13px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer; }
.sp-preview-form .sp-form-status { margin-top:14px;font-size:13px; }
.sp-property .sp-subnav { display:none!important; }
.sp-runtime.sp-nav-on .sp-subnav { display:flex!important;position:fixed;top:var(--sp-header,0px);left:0;right:0;z-index:90;width:100%;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;background:#f8f5ebf5;border-block:1px solid #d8d8cc;padding:0 5vw!important;gap:28px!important;scrollbar-width:none; }
.sp-subnav > .elementor-widget-button { width:auto;flex-shrink:0; }
.sp-subnav .elementor-button { min-height:60px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0!important;background:none!important;border-radius:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent!important; }
.sp-subnav .elementor-button[aria-current] { border-bottom-color:#617256!important;color:#43543c!important; }
.sp-runtime .sp-popup-source { display:none!important; }
.sp-popup-source { padding:30px!important;margin-block:25px;border:1px solid #d8d8cc;background:#f8f5eb; }
.sp-popup-source > .elementor-widget-heading { margin-bottom:24px; }
.sp-amenity-group { margin-top:22px; }
.sp-amenity-group ul { list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0; }
.sp-amenity-group li { padding:15px 0;border-top:1px solid #d8d8cc; }
.sp-dialog { width:min(720px,calc(100% - 32px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px);border:1px solid #d8d8cc;border-radius:8px;padding:0;color:#181a16;background:#fcfbf7;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain; }
.sp-dialog::backdrop { background:#171a16a6;backdrop-filter:blur(3px); }
.sp-dialog > .sp-popup-source { display:flex!important;margin:0;border:0;background:transparent;padding:32px!important; }
.sp-dialog-toolbar { position:sticky;top:0;background:#fcfbf7;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding:12px 16px;z-index:5;border-bottom:1px solid #d8d8cc; }
.sp-dialog-close { width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid #d8d8cc;border-radius:50%;background:#f8f5eb;color:#181a16;font:25px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer; }
.sp-dialog img { max-width:100%; }
.sp-gallery-dialog { width:min(1100px,calc(100% - 32px)); }
.sp-gallery-dialog .sp-gallery-content { padding:20px;display:grid;gap:18px; }
.sp-gallery-content img { display:block;width:100%;height:auto; }
body.sp-dialog-open { overflow:hidden; }
.sp-map { height:340px;width:100%;border:1px solid #d8d8cc;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin-block:24px;background:#eae5d9;z-index:0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif; }
.sp-map .leaflet-tile-pane { filter:saturate(.72) contrast(.95); }
.sp-map .leaflet-control-attribution { font-size:10px;background:#f8f5ebeb; }
.sp-map .leaflet-control-zoom a { background:#f8f5eb;color:#181a16; }
.sp-map-icon { background:none;border:0; }
.sp-map-logo { width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;background:white;border:8px solid #7e8e7644;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #181a162e; }
.sp-map-logo img { width:56px!important;height:56px!important;max-width:none!important;object-fit:contain; }
.sp-map-status { font:12px Arial,sans-serif; }
/* In Elementor the native popup containers stay visible and can be rearranged. */
.elementor-editor-active .sp-popup-source::before { content:'Editable popup content';font:600 12px Arial,sans-serif;color:#596650;margin-bottom:20px; }
@media(max-width:1000px) { .sp-property .sp-layout { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 310px;gap:32px; }.sp-property .sp-gallery { height:380px; } }
@media(max-width:800px) {
 .sp-property .sp-layout { grid-template-columns:1fr; }.sp-property .sp-booking { position:static; }
 .sp-property .sp-gallery { height:320px;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr; }.sp-gallery>.elementor-widget-image:nth-child(4),.sp-gallery>.elementor-widget-image:nth-child(5) { display:none; }
 .sp-property .sp-wrap { width:calc(100% - 40px);padding-top:14px; }.sp-property .sp-highlights { gap:14px; }.sp-subnav .elementor-button { min-height:56px;font-size:12px; }
 .sp-map { height:280px; }.sp-dialog>.sp-popup-source { padding:24px!important; }
}
@media(max-width:380px) { .sp-property .sp-highlights,.sp-property .sp-sleep-grid,.sp-amenities-preview ul { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

/* required styles */

.leaflet-pane,
.leaflet-tile,
.leaflet-marker-icon,
.leaflet-marker-shadow,
.leaflet-tile-container,
.leaflet-pane > svg,
.leaflet-pane > canvas,
.leaflet-zoom-box,
.leaflet-image-layer,
.leaflet-layer {
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	top: 0;
	}
.leaflet-container {
	overflow: hidden;
	}
.leaflet-tile,
.leaflet-marker-icon,
.leaflet-marker-shadow {
	-webkit-user-select: none;
	   -moz-user-select: none;
	        user-select: none;
	  -webkit-user-drag: none;
	}
/* Prevents IE11 from highlighting tiles in blue */
.leaflet-tile::selection {
	background: transparent;
}
/* Safari renders non-retina tile on retina better with this, but Chrome is worse */
.leaflet-safari .leaflet-tile {
	image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast;
	}
/* hack that prevents hw layers "stretching" when loading new tiles */
.leaflet-safari .leaflet-tile-container {
	width: 1600px;
	height: 1600px;
	-webkit-transform-origin: 0 0;
	}
.leaflet-marker-icon,
.leaflet-marker-shadow {
	display: block;
	}
/* .leaflet-container svg: reset svg max-width decleration shipped in Joomla! (joomla.org) 3.x */
/* .leaflet-container img: map is broken in FF if you have max-width: 100% on tiles */
.leaflet-container .leaflet-overlay-pane svg {
	max-width: none !important;
	max-height: none !important;
	}
.leaflet-container .leaflet-marker-pane img,
.leaflet-container .leaflet-shadow-pane img,
.leaflet-container .leaflet-tile-pane img,
.leaflet-container img.leaflet-image-layer,
.leaflet-container .leaflet-tile {
	max-width: none !important;
	max-height: none !important;
	width: auto;
	padding: 0;
	}

.leaflet-container img.leaflet-tile {
	/* See: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=600120 */
	mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter;
}

.leaflet-container.leaflet-touch-zoom {
	-ms-touch-action: pan-x pan-y;
	touch-action: pan-x pan-y;
	}
.leaflet-container.leaflet-touch-drag {
	-ms-touch-action: pinch-zoom;
	/* Fallback for FF which doesn't support pinch-zoom */
	touch-action: none;
	touch-action: pinch-zoom;
}
.leaflet-container.leaflet-touch-drag.leaflet-touch-zoom {
	-ms-touch-action: none;
	touch-action: none;
}
.leaflet-container {
	-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}
.leaflet-container a {
	-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(51, 181, 229, 0.4);
}
.leaflet-tile {
	filter: inherit;
	visibility: hidden;
	}
.leaflet-tile-loaded {
	visibility: inherit;
	}
.leaflet-zoom-box {
	width: 0;
	height: 0;
	-moz-box-sizing: border-box;
	     box-sizing: border-box;
	z-index: 800;
	}
/* workaround for https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=888319 */
.leaflet-overlay-pane svg {
	-moz-user-select: none;
	}

.leaflet-pane         { z-index: 400; }

.leaflet-tile-pane    { z-index: 200; }
.leaflet-overlay-pane { z-index: 400; }
.leaflet-shadow-pane  { z-index: 500; }
.leaflet-marker-pane  { z-index: 600; }
.leaflet-tooltip-pane   { z-index: 650; }
.leaflet-popup-pane   { z-index: 700; }

.leaflet-map-pane canvas { z-index: 100; }
.leaflet-map-pane svg    { z-index: 200; }

.leaflet-vml-shape {
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	}
.lvml {
	behavior: url(#default#VML);
	display: inline-block;
	position: absolute;
	}


/* control positioning */

.leaflet-control {
	position: relative;
	z-index: 800;
	pointer-events: visiblePainted; /* IE 9-10 doesn't have auto */
	pointer-events: auto;
	}
.leaflet-top,
.leaflet-bottom {
	position: absolute;
	z-index: 1000;
	pointer-events: none;
	}
.leaflet-top {
	top: 0;
	}
.leaflet-right {
	right: 0;
	}
.leaflet-bottom {
	bottom: 0;
	}
.leaflet-left {
	left: 0;
	}
.leaflet-control {
	float: left;
	clear: both;
	}
.leaflet-right .leaflet-control {
	float: right;
	}
.leaflet-top .leaflet-control {
	margin-top: 10px;
	}
.leaflet-bottom .leaflet-control {
	margin-bottom: 10px;
	}
.leaflet-left .leaflet-control {
	margin-left: 10px;
	}
.leaflet-right .leaflet-control {
	margin-right: 10px;
	}


/* zoom and fade animations */

.leaflet-fade-anim .leaflet-popup {
	opacity: 0;
	-webkit-transition: opacity 0.2s linear;
	   -moz-transition: opacity 0.2s linear;
	        transition: opacity 0.2s linear;
	}
.leaflet-fade-anim .leaflet-map-pane .leaflet-popup {
	opacity: 1;
	}
.leaflet-zoom-animated {
	-webkit-transform-origin: 0 0;
	    -ms-transform-origin: 0 0;
	        transform-origin: 0 0;
	}
svg.leaflet-zoom-animated {
	will-change: transform;
}

.leaflet-zoom-anim .leaflet-zoom-animated {
	-webkit-transition: -webkit-transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.25,1);
	   -moz-transition:    -moz-transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.25,1);
	        transition:         transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.25,1);
	}
.leaflet-zoom-anim .leaflet-tile,
.leaflet-pan-anim .leaflet-tile {
	-webkit-transition: none;
	   -moz-transition: none;
	        transition: none;
	}

.leaflet-zoom-anim .leaflet-zoom-hide {
	visibility: hidden;
	}


/* cursors */

.leaflet-interactive {
	cursor: pointer;
	}
.leaflet-grab {
	cursor: -webkit-grab;
	cursor:    -moz-grab;
	cursor:         grab;
	}
.leaflet-crosshair,
.leaflet-crosshair .leaflet-interactive {
	cursor: crosshair;
	}
.leaflet-popup-pane,
.leaflet-control {
	cursor: auto;
	}
.leaflet-dragging .leaflet-grab,
.leaflet-dragging .leaflet-grab .leaflet-interactive,
.leaflet-dragging .leaflet-marker-draggable {
	cursor: move;
	cursor: -webkit-grabbing;
	cursor:    -moz-grabbing;
	cursor:         grabbing;
	}

/* marker & overlays interactivity */
.leaflet-marker-icon,
.leaflet-marker-shadow,
.leaflet-image-layer,
.leaflet-pane > svg path,
.leaflet-tile-container {
	pointer-events: none;
	}

.leaflet-marker-icon.leaflet-interactive,
.leaflet-image-layer.leaflet-interactive,
.leaflet-pane > svg path.leaflet-interactive,
svg.leaflet-image-layer.leaflet-interactive path {
	pointer-events: visiblePainted; /* IE 9-10 doesn't have auto */
	pointer-events: auto;
	}

/* visual tweaks */

.leaflet-container {
	background: #ddd;
	outline-offset: 1px;
	}
.leaflet-container a {
	color: #0078A8;
	}
.leaflet-zoom-box {
	border: 2px dotted #38f;
	background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
	}


/* general typography */
.leaflet-container {
	font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
	font-size: 12px;
	font-size: 0.75rem;
	line-height: 1.5;
	}


/* general toolbar styles */

.leaflet-bar {
	box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);
	border-radius: 4px;
	}
.leaflet-bar a {
	background-color: #fff;
	border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc;
	width: 26px;
	height: 26px;
	line-height: 26px;
	display: block;
	text-align: center;
	text-decoration: none;
	color: black;
	}
.leaflet-bar a,
.leaflet-control-layers-toggle {
	background-position: 50% 50%;
	background-repeat: no-repeat;
	display: block;
	}
.leaflet-bar a:hover,
.leaflet-bar a:focus {
	background-color: #f4f4f4;
	}
.leaflet-bar a:first-child {
	border-top-left-radius: 4px;
	border-top-right-radius: 4px;
	}
.leaflet-bar a:last-child {
	border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
	border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
	border-bottom: none;
	}
.leaflet-bar a.leaflet-disabled {
	cursor: default;
	background-color: #f4f4f4;
	color: #bbb;
	}

.leaflet-touch .leaflet-bar a {
	width: 30px;
	height: 30px;
	line-height: 30px;
	}
